label: Iran
definition: Substantive discussion of Iran: its government, security, nuclear program, sanctions, human rights, diplomacy or explicitly linked regional actions. Do not infer presence from Middle East, Gaza, Gulf or Hormuz alone. A nationality adjective in a cultural quotation or speaker metadata alone does not qualify.

label: Cuba
definition: Substantive discussion of Cuba: embargo, sanctions, terrorism-list designation, energy restrictions, political or human-rights conditions, development, assistance or bilateral relations. Do not infer presence from Latin America or sanctions in general. A greeting, list of visiting delegations or speaker metadata alone does not qualify.

label: Ukraine
definition: Russia-Ukraine war, Russia-related European security, Black Sea or directly linked regional security.

label: AI
definition: Substantive discussion of artificial intelligence: governance, models, capability, access, investment, risk, safety, applications, standards or AI-enabled weapons. Generic digitalization, cyber policy, connectivity, algorithms or technology do not qualify without an explicit AI connection. Do not transfer a broad AI & digital code into this narrower category.

label: UN reform & representation
definition: Institutional reform, UN80, Security Council reform/representation, veto or leadership-selection issues.

label: Human rights, health & social
definition: Human rights, health, gender, children/youth, education and related social policy.

label: Other peace & security
definition: Substantive peace/security issues other than the separately coded Ukraine/Russia and Middle East categories, including peacekeeping, terrorism, crime, DRC/Haiti/Sudan/Afghanistan and disarmament.

label: AI & digital
definition: AI governance/capacity, digital policy, cyber issues and emerging-technology governance.

label: Development & finance
definition: Development financing, debt/financial architecture, SDGs, jobs, industrialization, investment, taxation, technology transfer.

label: Climate & environment
definition: Climate mitigation/adaptation/finance, biodiversity, oceans, drought/flood, water security and environmental policy.

label: Middle East
definition: Israel/Palestine/Gaza, Iran/Gulf/Hormuz, Golan and directly linked regional issues.

label: Humanitarian, migration & refugees
definition: Humanitarian assistance/access, migration, displacement, refugees and asylum/return issues.

label: Sovereignty & territorial disputes
definition: Self-determination, territorial disputes/claims, decolonization, Kosovo, Cyprus, Essequibo and analogous disputes.
